question.problem: Let $B=\{2,4,6,8\}.$ Which of the following is equivalent to ${1}_{B}(4)?$
question.worked_solution:
The indicator function $1[P]$ equals $1$ if the predicate $P$ is true and $0$ if $P$ is false.

$$
1[P]=\{\begin{aligned}1, & \text{if }P\text{ is true}, \\ 0, & \text{if }P\text{ is false}.\end{aligned}
$$

Recall that the indicator function ${1}_{B}(x)$ of a set $B$ equals $1$ if $x\in B$ and $0$ if $x\notin B.$ This can be written using Iverson bracket notation as

$$
{1}_{B}(x)=1[x\in B].
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
{1}_{B}(4)=1[4\in B]=1[4\in \{2,4,6,8\}].
$$
